name: v0.3.53 — New app icon, tidy bottom bar, fun loader
releaseNotes:
• Fresh app icon — the avocado with a sprout on the GetGuac green.
• Bottom bar tidied up — all labels sit on one line, no empty space, and the centre camera is the highlight.
• In-app web screens now show a flipping avocado while they load instead of a plain spinner.
